title: MERGE-XAI-SYNC C-06 (PIN D12/M2, schema goldens + catalog hydration + CMO round-trip) — fresh hermetic boot on gpt-5.6-sol (frozen lane L-01): every case boots fresh (hermetic home = copied config + aligned models_cache), so the boot surface is exercised on the lane of record. SMOKE-SURFACED (this cell): (1) the boot completes (exit 0, echo turn closes); (2) CATALOG HYDRATION: the boot fetches GET /v1/models through the wiretap and the response is 200 — the catalog hydrates FROM THE PROXY into the hermetic home's models_cache.json (the hydration path under OUR boot path post-merge; the 1.0.25-class concurrent-boot isolation is the separate DRIFT cell C-10); (3) CMO WIRE FACE: the sol request carries the 'summary' CMO field (reasoning_summary, theirs-side member of the merged CMO). GATE-DEPENDENT (named, not smoke-mechanical): config.schema.json + config.reference.html golden match (D12 — the goldens are CRATE test fixtures; the wave-3 full gate step 6 runs them after the D12 golden regen) and the CMO round-trip of reasoning_summary+cache_ttl parsing (M15 drift guard — a crate test). The coordinator cross-checks the gate results against this cell's wire face on the matrix board. VERDICT: PASS = boot clean + hydration 200 + CMO summary field on the wire. STOP-AND-REPORT: a boot failure, a non-200 /v1/models, or a missing summary field (the CMO member dropped on the wire).

steps.note: GATE DEPENDENCY (named per 06 C-06): the config.schema.json + config.reference.html goldens (D12, regen'd LAST in the merge execution) and the CMO round-trip parse of reasoning_summary+cache_ttl (M15 drift guard) are CRATE TESTS in the wave-3 full gate (step 6) — not smoke-mechanical. This cell pins the LIVE boot + catalog-hydration surface + the CMO wire face; the matrix board cross-references both.

ndjson.label: BOOT CLEAN: the fresh hermetic boot + first turn completed without a terminal error (a boot-time config parse failure = the M2/D12 cluster regressed -> STOP).
FRESH BOOT TURNS: the post-boot turn closed with the exact terminal text.

wire.label: CATALOG HYDRATION PIN: the boot fetched GET /v1/models through the wiretap (1 = the clean shape; 2-3 = tolerated refreshes). 0 = the boot did NOT hydrate the catalog from the proxy (it rode the pre-aligned cache only) = the hydration path is dead on our boot path post-merge = defect.
CATALOG ACCEPTED: the first /v1/models fetch returned 200 — the catalog hydrates from the proxy into models_cache.json under the post-merge boot path.

CMO WIRE FACE (M15/M2): the sol request carries the 'summary' CMO field (reasoning_summary, theirs-side member of the merged CMO) on the responses reasoning block — the CMO member survived the merge onto the wire. The struct-level ROUND-TRIP parse (both reasoning_summary + cache_ttl) is the M15 crate test in the full gate (named in the title).
VERDICT RECORD (recon, newest request): the turn's capture timestamp — the boot-completion evidence anchor for the board.
